message: Field "Clock.optional" is optional and its value comes from @updatedAt, which Prisma 8 cannot express on an optional field yet. Remove @updatedAt and keep the "?": the database does not change, and both clients then stop filling the value.

Field "Clock.defaulted" combines @updatedAt with @default(now()), which Prisma 8 cannot express yet. Remove @default(now()): @updatedAt still sets the value on create and on update, and Prisma 7's next migration removes the column default.

Field "Clock.optionalDefaulted" combines @updatedAt with @default(now()), which Prisma 8 cannot express yet. Remove @default(now()): @updatedAt still sets the value on create and on update, and Prisma 7's next migration removes the column default.
